The good-creation specialization is not triggered by the material phrase.

The unresolved branches are retained only as attributed contextual evidence.

The exact HFT trace supplies the focus's authorized emergence from death and the pericope's later taking, watching, sovereignty, and capacity coordinates. Every supplied role returns to a focus permission, emergence, or death carrier, so unresolved branches remain visible in attributed mode.

The HFT trace gives exact focus coordinates for the paired favor and maternal naming, plus exact 5:116 and 5:117 contacts that test sourcehood and worship. The unresolved contextual branches are retained as attributed evidence without invented lexical glosses.

findings.title: Speech and teaching form one supported life
findings.claim: Within the judgment, revelation, and witness frame of the pericope, the remembered support, spirit, speech, teaching, and life-stage terms form one authorized communicative life from the cradle to mature age.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies the exact speech-and-teaching carriers, while the surrounding revelation, knowledge, witness, commanded-speech, and finite-period occurrences give those capacities a pericope-level frame of authorized testimony rather than a disconnected catalogue.
findings.reader_payoff: The infancy and maturity phrases become two contained points on the same supported communicative span, and the curriculum of book and wisdom can be read alongside the later language of command and witness.
findings.containment: This does not claim that every listed branch is the direct dictionary sense of its focus form, nor that the pericope resolves the source variants in spirit, maturity, or teaching. The protective branch remains a bounded contextual reinforcement, and no whole-surah claim is made.

epistemic.reason: The channel support and all cited focus/context surfaces are trusted packet evidence; the synthesis is a bounded relation among them.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın çekirdeği yoğun güç ve güçlü kılma işlemidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries completed strengthening of Jesus.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The pericope's revelation to the disciples supplies an independent authorized-transmission context.
branch_activations.activation: The remembered strengthening meets the later revelation-and-response frame, so support is read as an enabling condition for communicative mission.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The support is part of a sustained authorized capacity, not an isolated force display.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not identify the support with every form of aid or claim a separate lexical sense beyond the supplied strengthening branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın çekirdeği, bir şeyi koruyan engel ya da dayanak oluşudur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus says that Jesus was strengthened.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later pericope calls God the continuing watcher after Jesus's finite presence.
branch_activations.activation: Strengthening contacts the watcher frame as protective reinforcement around the mission's communicative life.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The support can be perceived as a guarding reinforcement while remaining anchored in the focus's direct strengthening.
branch_activations.boundary: This is not a claim that the focus verb directly names a physical barrier or that protection replaces strengthening.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bilgi ve usla doğruyu bulma yetkinliği
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bilgi ve us, kişinin doğruyu yanlıştan ayırıp doğru olana ulaşmasını sağlar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names wisdom among what was taught.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding judgment frame twice invokes knowledge and the knower of the unseen.
branch_activations.activation: Wisdom contacts the judgment frame through the pericope's explicit knowledge language.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The taught wisdom is placed within discernment before testimony, not treated as decorative curriculum.
branch_activations.boundary: No specific judicial verdict or complete theory of wisdom is added beyond the supplied branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İç varlık bedene canlılık verir ve onun ayrılması beden yaşamının sona ermesini bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names the spirit as the means of support.

branch_activations.activation: The spirit-as-support carrier meets the later revelation response, making the enabling medium part of a living mission rather than an unconnected label.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The spirit is heard as the life-giving support alongside the speech that follows.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet preserves the source variant about the spirit's relation to the self and does not identify the spirit with revelation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form II teaching verb carries knowledge being produced in Jesus.

branch_activations.activation: Teaching contacts witness through the shared movement from received knowledge to publicly answerable testimony.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The teaching is an active transmission process within the same authorized communicative life.
branch_activations.boundary: The associated teaching facet is retained; the focus is not being recast as a generic statement about every kind of knowing.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: arınma, arıtma ve eksiklikten uzak sayma

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The holy quality of the support remains perceptible when the pericope later guards divine sourcehood.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not import concrete objects or place names from the branch and does not turn the later declaration into a gloss for the focus phrase.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İşlemin ürünü, yazılmış metin veya üzerinde bu metnin bulunduğu sayfa ya da kitaptır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The book is read as a durable form of taught guidance within the same mission arc.
branch_activations.boundary: No binding legal sense or unstated identity of the book is asserted.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: anlaşılır konuşma, hitap ve söz alışverişi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, dinleyenin anlayabileceği biçimde söz üretmektir.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, tek başına anlam taşıyan bir harf veya harflerden oluşmuş tek bir söz birimidir.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi gençliğin sonunu aşmış ve olgunluk evresine girmiş bir erkektir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Maturity is a stage within the authorized life that carries speech and witness before absence.
branch_activations.boundary: No exact age threshold or source variant is selected.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir bebeğin uyumasına ayrılan ve bu amaçla hazırlanmış somut bir yerdir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus places speech in the cradle.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later pericope describes witness during a bounded period of presence.
branch_activations.activation: The prepared cradle as the first life-stage setting contacts the later finite-period witness setting.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The cradle and maturity references together trace the span of one communicative mission.
branch_activations.boundary: The cradle is not turned into a metaphor for the whole pericope or for later judgment.

findings.title: A formed sign moves through material stages
findings.claim: The table episode supplies a pericope-level sign context in which the focus's clay, form, breath, becoming, bird, and repeated permission can be perceived as a staged material process whose motion remains authorized.
findings.mechanism: The focus provides exact carriers for clay, form, creation, breath, becoming, and bird; the adjacent request for a sign, the prayer for an ayah, and the descent of the table independently supply a material-sign and reception frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The sequence reads as material, shaped form, directed breath, becoming, and flight, while the repeated permission keeps the stages from presenting the object as self-originating.
findings.containment: The innate-constitution branch under root_000963 is excluded because the actual carrier is material clay. The remaining form branches are contextual relations and do not rewrite the focus as a technical account of measurement or manufacture.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel support, exact focus carriers, and the supplied 5:112-115 context jointly ground the bounded staged reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel ilişki, bir kişiye belirli bir işi yapma veya bir yere girme onayı ve yetkisi vermektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated permission noun marks the acts as authorized.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The disciples ask about the capacity for a sign, and Jesus asks for the table as an ayah from God.
branch_activations.activation: The permission refrain contacts the explicit sign-request frame, making authorization the hinge of the material sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The form, breath, becoming, and healing acts remain delegated within a sign episode.
branch_activations.boundary: Permission is not treated as an independent claim that the focus actors possess unlimited power.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Nesnenin ölçüsü ve sınırları yapılacak işten önce belirlenir.
branch_activations.carrier: The creation verb introduces the shaping of a thing from clay in a bird form.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later prayer names the requested table as a sign from God.
branch_activations.activation: The sign context makes the pre-flight formation read as a bounded, determined form before animation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The material sign has a defined formative stage before breath and motion.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus is not being recast as a detailed measurement procedure.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey ortaya çıkarılır ve varlık kazanır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries bringing a clay-formed thing into being.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The table prayer asks for a visible sign and names its source relation.
branch_activations.activation: The requested sign supplies an independent appearance frame for the focus's emergence of the formed object.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Creation is heard as the first visible stage of a sign that later becomes mobile.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made about an unprovided metaphysical account of creation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dış biçim tamamlanmış ve gözle seçilebilir durumdadır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus pairs creation with the explicit bird-like form.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The pericope calls for a visible ayah and repeatedly discusses signs.
branch_activations.activation: The sign frame makes the completed exterior form a necessary perceptible stage before breath and flight.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The formed shape is a visible, bounded component of the sign.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is limited to outward form and does not claim inner character or beauty.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kanatlı canlı ve onun havada ilerleme hareketi dalın ortak çekirdeğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names the bird form and the resulting bird.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The table request seeks a witnessed, verifiable sign.
branch_activations.activation: Bird and flight contact witness because the mobile result is the observable completion of the sign sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Flight is the outward completion of the formed-and-breathed sign.
branch_activations.boundary: No figurative speed, horse, textile, or abundance use is imported.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: su ile toprağın karışmasından oluşan çamur

branch_activations.boundary: The excluded innate-constitution branch is not included; this activation stays with physical clay.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The table context supplies God's stated act of bringing the sign down.
branch_activations.activation: Becoming and descent meet as two stages in which a sign enters manifest existence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The bird's becoming is a realized stage of the sign, not an unmarked transition.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is not extended to place, possession, or unrelated causative uses.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hava ya da soluk, bir şeyin içine veya üzerine gider ya da gönderilir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Breath is the middle stage that connects form to the bird's becoming.
branch_activations.boundary: No spontaneous swelling, bellows, animal sound, or eschatological blowing use is asserted.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeyin içinde bulunduğu durum veya görünüş biçimi

branch_activations.activation: The object's form contacts the sign's required perceptibility.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Shape is the sign's visible state before it moves.
branch_activations.boundary: The reading stays with form and does not claim clothing or mere beauty.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir iş için hazır duruma gelme veya bir şeyi hazırlayıp düzeltme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi veya işi düzelterek, düzenleyerek ve gerekli duruma getirerek hazırlamak.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The disciples' request and the subsequent descent of a requested sign establish a preparation-to-manifestation sequence.
branch_activations.activation: Prepared form contacts the later requested material sign as an object made ready for its next stage.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The form is not only appearance; it is the prepared condition for breath and becoming.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that the focus verb itself means preparation in every context.

findings.title: Closed conditions open into restored life
findings.claim: The pericope's sign-and-reception context lets the focus's healing, bodily affliction, emergence, and death terms form an opening sequence in which closed perception and life are brought toward visible restoration by permission.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies exact carriers for healing, the leprous condition, visual appearance, blindness, emergence, and death; the later request for a witnessed sign and the warning after disbelief supply the independent macro frame.
findings.reader_payoff: Healing and bringing out the dead can be seen as related openings from bodily or vital closure, while the visible mark remains part of the sign's public surface.
findings.containment: The root_001308/B008 blindness branch is excluded because the supplied كَفَفْتُ عَنْكَ construction means holding back. The retained visual and directional branches remain bounded contextual facets, not replacements for the direct affliction readings.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel supplies the healing/restoration relation, and every retained carrier and context coordinate is present in the packet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel ilişki, bir kişiye belirli bir işi yapma veya bir yere girme onayı ve yetkisi vermektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated permission noun accompanies the healing and life-opening acts.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The table prayer names a sign from God and the following ayah states that it will descend.
branch_activations.activation: The sign frame contacts the repeated permission refrain as the controlling hinge of restoration.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The openings into healing and life remain authorized acts within the sign sequence.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent agency or unlimited power is assigned to the focus actor.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus healing form carries the supplied recovery-from-illness image.

branch_activations.activation: The healing form contacts those named illnesses and the channel's opening operation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The branch's recovery image is retained as a source-semantic image attached to the healing act.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is nominated rather than lexically registered in the packet; no invented facet or verified lexical identity is claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanda bu beyazlaşma bir hastalık ve bu hastalığı taşıyan kişinin niteliği olarak kullanılır.

branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not claim every white mark or every visual condition is leprosy.

branch_activations.activation: The named bodily mark contacts the visual-sign frame as an attached appearance facet.

branch_activations.boundary: This is a visual contextual relation, not a claim that the focus word directly means sparkle or that disease and sparkle are identical.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir etken, başka bir varlığı bulunduğu yerden çıkarır veya görünür duruma getirir.

branch_activations.activation: Causative emergence contacts the manifest-sign request as an opening from concealment into public visibility.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: doğuştan körlük ve buna bağlanan görme yitimi değişkeleri
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi doğuştan kördür veya gözleri doğuştan görme işlevinden yoksundur.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: nereye gideceğini bilmeden ilerleme ve yönünü bulamama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi nereye yöneldiğini bilmeden başını alıp ilerler.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Restoration can be perceived as opening both sight and the capacity to find a direction.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a bounded consequence relation; the focus is not being declared a separate scene of wandering.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yaşamın ve canlı gücünün sona ermesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Canlıdaki güç ve yaşam sona erer; bu durum yaşamın karşıtıdır.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later context makes response after a sign the point of warning.
branch_activations.activation: Death contacts the sign-and-reception frame as the most complete closed condition in the focus's opening sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Bringing out the dead extends restoration from bodily affliction to the termination of life.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made about kinds of death beyond the supplied core.

findings.title: Disclosure leaves reception answerable
findings.claim: The table request and its warning sharpen the focus's ending into a failed-reception event: disclosed signs can produce assurance, verification, and witness, yet remain resistible, so relabeling them after disclosure carries heightened responsibility.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies clear proofs, disbelief, and the magic label; 5:113 supplies the requested effects of settled hearts, truthful verification, and witness, while 5:115 supplies disbelief after descent and exceptional punitive consequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The final accusation becomes part of the pericope's movement from sign to reception and accountability rather than an incidental hostile remark.
findings.containment: The packet's HFT identity is legacy_unbound and its unresolved branches have no verified gloss or facet; they are retained only in attributed mode. The inference does not claim that the table episode is the only possible frame for 5:110's ending.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace and packet anchors are present, but the synthesis is legacy-unbound and the unresolved contextual branches are not registered lexical evidence.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Açık kanıt, açık işaret veya belirgin belge olarak adlaşmış kullanımı vardır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names manifest proofs and a manifesting adjective.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The HFT trace assigns settled assurance, verification, and witness to the table request.
branch_activations.activation: Manifest proof contacts those three requested receptions, making disclosure the condition for accountable response.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The signs are clear enough to ground answerability without coercing assent.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed HFT contextual relation; it does not supply a new lexical branch or claim that clarity guarantees belief.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yanlışı doğru görünümünde sunarak kişiyi aldatır veya gözün gerçekte olmayan bir şeyi varmış gibi algılamasına yol açar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's magic label carries the supplied deceptive-diversion branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later context repeats disbelief after the sign has descended.
branch_activations.activation: The counter-label contacts post-sign refusal as the interpretive move that diverts the disclosed sign.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Calling the sign magic can be seen as a counter-explanation that neutralizes its disclosure for rejecters.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed reading does not decide whether the accusation is psychologically deliberate or establish a general definition of magic.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus filters the speakers as those who disbelieved.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later table warning names disbelief after the sign.
branch_activations.activation: The focus subset and the later post-sign condition contact one another as a reception failure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The accusation is situated in a defined group response rather than presented as the voice of all Israelites.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not disclose the inner state or exact motive of each member of the subset.

findings.mechanism: The focus supplies emergence, death, and repeated permission; 5:117 supplies God's taking and watching after Jesus's finite presence, and 5:120 supplies ownership and effective capacity over everything.
findings.reader_payoff: The final permission attached to the dead is read within an asymmetrical custody in which the delegate acts locally while the source retains the power to take, watch, and own universally.
findings.containment: The HFT reader is legacy_unbound, and unresolved branches are attributed without invented glosses. The reading does not deny the focus's resurrection wonder or turn successive pericope scenes into a proof of one exclusive agency model.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT coordinates and focus/context surfaces are supplied, but the cross-scene agency hierarchy is an attributed contextual synthesis.

findings.reader_payoff: The mother's inclusion becomes structurally active: the paired beneficiary grammar can be carried into the later recipient-versus-source question without collapsing either person into the other.
findings.containment: The HFT trace is legacy_unbound and its mother, besides, and worship branches are unresolved; they are retained only as attributed contextual roles. The packet's live alternative that the maternal pairing expresses honor alone remains open.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and pericope coordinates are supplied, while the paired recipient/source synthesis is carried by a legacy-unbound HFT trace.
